title: 牽引變電所整合~Traction-substation integration
focus: 牽引變壓整流負載與保護邊界~Traction transformation rectification load and protection boundaries
summary: 牽引變電所整合以「牽引變壓整流負載與保護邊界」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。變電所整合需要分辨電壓層級、交流相量、直流回路與能量帳，額定設備容量不能直接代表供電區間可同時支援的列車數。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops traction transformation rectification load and protection boundaries through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Substation integration distinguishes voltage levels, AC phasors, DC circuits and energy balances; equipment ratings do not directly establish how many trains a feeding section supports. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把牽引變電所整合放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。變電所整合需要分辨電壓層級、交流相量、直流回路與能量帳，額定設備容量不能直接代表供電區間可同時支援的列車數。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Traction-substation integration in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Substation integration distinguishes voltage levels, AC phasors, DC circuits and energy balances; equipment ratings do not directly establish how many trains a feeding section supports. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。只把 primary 增加百分之十，y=1100 V。模型邊界：理想單相變壓器幅值比；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A；y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA。只把 Vline 增加百分之十，y=10.4789 MVA。模型邊界：平衡三相正弦系統；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V. Increasing only primary with a ten-percent increase gives y=1100 V. Boundary: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A; y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA. Increasing only Vline with a ten-percent increase gives y=10.4789 MVA. Boundary: Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 變壓器電壓比~Transformer voltage ratio
units.title: 變壓器電壓比~Transformer voltage ratio
units.mechanism: 理想匝數比改變電壓而近似保存功率。本模型把 primary 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1100 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想單相變壓器幅值比。使用次側空載電壓與匝比作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~An ideal turns ratio changes voltage while approximately conserving power. In this model, primary is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1100 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio. Use secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。只把 primary 增加百分之十，y=1100 V。模型邊界：理想單相變壓器幅值比；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V. Increasing only primary with a ten-percent increase gives y=1100 V. Boundary: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以次側空載電壓與匝比區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓縮比變壓器建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「變壓器電壓比」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage scaled transformer, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Transformer voltage ratio. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比。這個失效與「變壓器電壓比」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查次側空載電壓與匝比，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio. This failure and a measurement bias in Transformer voltage ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio.
units.practice: 重算「變壓器電壓比」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想單相變壓器幅值比如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比造成偏離的合成觀察，以次側空載電壓與匝比說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Transformer voltage ratio, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio. Explain which evidence in secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 三相視在功率~Three-phase apparent power
units.title: 三相視在功率~Three-phase apparent power
units.mechanism: 線電壓與線電流的三相關係包含根號三。本模型把 Vline 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 10.4789 MVA。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。平衡三相正弦系統。使用三相電壓電流與平衡度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~The three-phase relation between line voltage and line current includes square root of three. In this model, Vline is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 10.4789 MVA. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system. Use three-phase voltage, current and balance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A；y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA。只把 Vline 增加百分之十，y=10.4789 MVA。模型邊界：平衡三相正弦系統；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A; y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA. Increasing only Vline with a ten-percent increase gives y=10.4789 MVA. Boundary: Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以三相電壓電流與平衡度區分模型與觀察，先用合成三相功率分析資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「三相視在功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use three-phase voltage, current and balance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic three-phase power-analyzer data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Three-phase apparent power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差。這個失效與「三相視在功率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查三相電壓電流與平衡度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error. This failure and a measurement bias in Three-phase apparent power can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check three-phase voltage, current and balance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「三相視在功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出平衡三相正弦系統如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差造成偏離的合成觀察，以三相電壓電流與平衡度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Three-phase apparent power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system. units.anchor: 實功率與功因~Real power and power factor
units.title: 實功率與功因~Real power and power factor
units.mechanism: 功率因數把視在功率分成可用實功部分。本模型把 S 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.9 MW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已知總功率因數。使用有功無功與波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；畸變功因不能只用相位角描述，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Power factor relates apparent power to real power. In this model, S is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9.9 MW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Known total power factor. Use real/reactive power and waveforms as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Distortion power factor is not described by phase angle alone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1；y=S*pf=9 MW。只把 S 增加百分之十，y=9.9 MW。模型邊界：已知總功率因數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1; y=S*pf=9 MW. units.verify: 本單元以有功無功與波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成功率分析儀輸出建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「實功率與功因」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use real/reactive power and waveforms to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.anchor: 整流理想平均電壓~Ideal rectifier mean voltage
units.title: 整流理想平均電壓~Ideal rectifier mean voltage
units.mechanism: 六脈波理想整流平均值取決於交流線電壓。本模型把 Vll 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 891.313 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。連續電流理想三相二極體橋。使用直流均值與交流線電壓作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；換相壓降與元件壓降使真值較低，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Ideal six-pulse mean DC voltage depends on AC line voltage. units.anchor: 供電線路壓降~Feeder voltage drop
units.title: 供電線路壓降~Feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 回路電阻與電流共同消耗受電端電壓。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 99 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。直流穩態完整回路。使用源端與負載端電壓作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只計去路導線會漏掉回流壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Loop resistance and current consume receiving-end voltage. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 99 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Complete DC loop in steady state. Use source and load terminal voltages as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only the outgoing conductor misses return drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1500 A, R=0.06 ohm；y=I*R=90 V。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=99 V。模型邊界：直流穩態完整回路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=1500 A, R=0.06 ohm; y=I*R=90 V. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=99 V. Boundary: Complete DC loop in steady state; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以源端與負載端電壓區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓雙端電壓量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「供電線路壓降」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use source and load terminal voltages to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage measurements at both ends, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Feeder voltage drop. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只計去路導線會漏掉回流壓降。這個失效與「供電線路壓降」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查源端與負載端電壓，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Counting only the outgoing conductor misses return drop. This failure and a measurement bias in Feeder voltage drop can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check source and load terminal voltages rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計去路導線會漏掉回流壓降~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only the outgoing conductor misses return drop.
units.practice: 重算「供電線路壓降」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出直流穩態完整回路如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只計去路導線會漏掉回流壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以源端與負載端電壓說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Feeder voltage drop, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Complete DC loop in steady state. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Counting only the outgoing conductor misses return drop. Explain which evidence in source and load terminal voltages distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 設備效率能量帳~Equipment efficiency energy account
units.title: 設備效率能量帳~Equipment efficiency energy account
units.mechanism: 效率連結相同邊界與時窗的輸入輸出能量。本模型把 Ein 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1067 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定效率與同時窗。使用兩側電能積分作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；輔助負載遺漏會高估整站效率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Efficiency relates input and output energy on the same boundary and window. In this model, Ein is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1067 kWh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed efficiency over one common window. Use energy integration at both terminals as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitted auxiliary loads overstate station efficiency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Ein=1000 kWh, eta=0.97 1；y=Ein*eta=970 kWh。只把 Ein 增加百分之十，y=1067 kWh。模型邊界：固定效率與同時窗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: Ein=1000 kWh, eta=0.97 1; y=Ein*eta=970 kWh. Increasing only Ein with a ten-percent increase gives y=1067 kWh. Boundary: Fixed efficiency over one common window; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.practice: 重算「設備效率能量帳」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定效率與同時窗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由輔助負載遺漏會高估整站效率造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩側電能積分說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Equipment efficiency energy account, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed efficiency over one common window. units.anchor: 尖峰需求滑動平均~Moving-average peak demand
units.title: 尖峰需求滑動平均~Moving-average peak demand
units.mechanism: 需量是指定時窗能量除時間而非瞬時功率。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2640 kW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定十五分鐘觀察窗。使用滑動時窗與電能作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；時窗對齊不同可改變記錄尖峰，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Demand divides window energy by duration rather than taking instantaneous power. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2640 kW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Specified fifteen-minute observation window. Use moving windows and electrical energy as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different window alignment changes recorded peaks; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=600 kWh, minutes=15 min；y=E/(minutes/60)=2400 kW。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=2640 kW。模型邊界：固定十五分鐘觀察窗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=600 kWh, minutes=15 min; y=E/(minutes/60)=2400 kW. Boundary: Specified fifteen-minute observation window; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

This failure and a measurement bias in Moving-average peak demand can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check moving windows and electrical energy rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.anchor: 短路等效電流~Equivalent short-circuit current
units.title: 短路等效電流~Equivalent short-circuit current
units.mechanism: 故障電流受等效源阻抗而不只由額定電流決定。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11000 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。僅離線線性等效幅值，不含直流偏置。使用等效源阻抗與波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Fault current depends on source impedance rather than rated current alone. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11000 A. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Offline linear equivalent magnitude without DC offset. Use equivalent source impedance and waveform as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=1000 V, Z=0.1 ohm；y=V/Z=10000 A。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=11000 A。模型邊界：僅離線線性等效幅值，不含直流偏置；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=1000 V, Z=0.1 ohm; y=V/Z=10000 A. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=11000 A. Boundary: Offline linear equivalent magnitude without DC offset; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.title: 母線熱損耗~Busbar thermal loss
units.mechanism: 接點小電阻在大電流下仍產生明顯熱量。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 968 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定電阻的穩態電損。使用接點電阻與溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；鬆動接點會提高局部發熱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Small joint resistance can generate substantial heat at high current. Explain which evidence in joint resistance and temperature rise distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 備援容量算例~Redundant-capacity example
units.mechanism: 一台不可用時的名義餘量仍須檢查網路供電路徑。本模型把 units 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 14 MVA。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同額定單元且可完全分攤。使用供電拓樸與剩餘容量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Nominal reserve after one unavailable unit still requires a viable network path. In this model, units is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 14 MVA. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal-rated units with fully shareable loading. Use feeding topology and remaining capacity as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：units=3 count, each=10 MVA, load=16 MVA；y=(units-1)*each-load=4 MVA。只把 units 增加一個整數單位，y=14 MVA。模型邊界：相同額定單元且可完全分攤；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: units=3 count, each=10 MVA, load=16 MVA; y=(units-1)*each-load=4 MVA. Increasing only units with an increase of one whole unit gives y=14 MVA. Boundary: Equal-rated units with fully shareable loading; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以供電拓樸與剩餘容量區分模型與觀察，先用離線單線圖與情境表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「備援容量算例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use feeding topology and remaining capacity to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using offline single-line diagram and scenario table, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Redundant-capacity example. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電。這個失效與「備援容量算例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查供電拓樸與剩餘容量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load. This failure and a measurement bias in Redundant-capacity example can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check feeding topology and remaining capacity rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load.
units.practice: 重算「備援容量算例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出相同額定單元且可完全分攤如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電造成偏離的合成觀察，以供電拓樸與剩餘容量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Redundant-capacity example, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equal-rated units with fully shareable loading. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load. Explain which evidence in feeding topology and remaining capacity distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
